surface_mechanism_description: The surface reactions during ALD of TiO2 on polyamide particles involve the alternating exposure of the surface to titanium tetrachloride (TiCl4) and water (H2O) vapors. The process begins with the adsorption of TiCl4 molecules, followed by the reaction with surface hydroxyl groups (OH*), forming a surface intermediate (Ti-OH*). Subsequently, the surface is exposed to H2O, which reacts with the Ti-OH* intermediate to form TiO2 and release HCl. The cycle is repeated to build up the TiO2 film layer by layer.
